vocabulary.definition: an unreasonable dislike of certain types of people
vocabulary.example: The Human Library features individuals who have faced prejudice in their lives.

vocabulary.definition: people who freely offer to do something
vocabulary.example: The human books in The Human Library are volunteers who share their experiences.

vocabulary.definition: causing difficulty; hard to do or deal with
vocabulary.example: Visiting readers are encouraged to ask awkward questions to the human books.

vocabulary.definition: fixed ideas about what a particular type of person is like
vocabulary.example: The main idea of The Human Library is to challenge assumptions and stereotypes about others.

vocabulary.definition: to make someone upset or angry
vocabulary.example: Participants in the Human Library are encouraged to ask questions without worrying about offending the human 'books'.

vocabulary.definition: acknowledging and showing appreciation for an event or achievement
vocabulary.example: The Human Library is all about celebrating people's differences and diversity.
